title: HeavyMap
summary: A technical scaffold for the HeavyMap tool: industrial intelligence for the cross-border Niagara area, assembled from public data.
why: The tool reads different kinds of public data about the same places. This subsite is where that reading is explained. It is scaffolding, not a data release.
span: HeavyMap is the name of this subsite. Its seed coverage is the cross-border Niagara area: Niagara Region, the Ontario upper-tier municipality, plus Niagara County and Erie County in New York. Niagara Region is one place inside that coverage, not the name of the whole.
focus: This subsite is technical. It is about the HeavyMap tool and the public datasets that tool is built to read. It is not a profile of companies.
topicNote: A data kind for this subsite. The list is seed scaffolding, not a finished catalogue.

sections.title: Layers and data catalogue
sections.summary: Coverage of each public dataset, stated per place. Nothing is catalogued yet.
paragraphs: A layer entry will say which places it covers and which dataset it came from. This scaffold has no layer rows.
The places in the seed region are not a coverage map. An empty catalogue is not a claim that a place has no data.

sections.title: Claims and refusals
sections.summary: Named method slots for how a claim is graded, stamped, or refused. No scale is defined here.
paragraphs: Evidence grades are a named method slot. This scaffold does not define a scale.
Source stamps are a named method slot. This scaffold does not define a stamp format.
Refusal codes named for this scaffold are not_in_coverage, not_licensed, and not_joined. They are names only. They are not applied to a dataset on this page.
Forbidden words are a named method slot. This scaffold does not list them.

sections.title: Licences and publication limits
sections.summary: What a later release may legally carry. No licence matrix is filled in.
paragraphs: A data piece still names its own licence in front matter. This page does not substitute for that.
Publication limits are not written out here. Nothing on this subsite is a public data release.

sections.title: Geography and coverage
sections.summary: The seed region for HeavyMap, and what it is not.
paragraphs: The seed region id is region:heavymap. Its members are Niagara Region (the Ontario upper-tier municipality), Niagara County, New York, and Erie County, New York. Towns inside those members are inside the region.
Niagara Region is that Ontario municipality. It is not the name of this subsite and not the name of the whole coverage.
Greater Niagara is a different subsite. Its seed region is wider: Ontario and New York. Hamilton and Rochester are in the shared place file and are not members of region:heavymap.
The atlas study area is a separate coverage term for data the atlas holds. This page does not state that coverage.
